## Route Handlers

Route Handlers allow you to create custom request handlers for a given route using the Web [Request](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Request) and [Response](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Response) APIs.

TypeScript compiles cleanly. Here's what I created:

1. **`app/api/users/profile/route.ts`** — API route handler returning mock user data (`{ name: 'Jane Doe', email: 'jane@example.com' }`) using the Next.js App Router `GET` export + `Response.json()` pattern.

2. **`app/UserProfile.tsx`** — Async server component following the existing `getProducts` pattern: an async fetch with try/catch fallback, displaying `name` and `email` in plain HTML (matching the unstyled convention used by `ProductList`).
